physicalNotes: Radius: 0.224 solar radii and mass 0.193 solar masses from the TESS Input Catalog v8.2 (TIC 256364937; Stassun et al. 2019, AJ 158, 138), which derives both for cool dwarfs from the Ks magnitude and distance (Mann et al. 2015, 2019). Model-dependent values, not measurements of this star's disc. presentationUp: no axis is measured, so the display axis is celestial north at the star.

sources.position: Gaia DR3 source 1827242816176111360 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hd-189733-companion/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv: 11.44 arcsec from HD 189733 A at position angle 244 degrees, 226 au in projection
sources.distance: HD 189733 A's Gaia DR3 distance, 19.776 pc. B's own parallax, 50.629 +/- 0.014 mas (19.752 pc), differs from A's by 0.06 mas; taken literally it would put B 5,000 au nearer than A, 20 times its projected separation, although the pair moves together. The depth between them is not measured.
sources.radialVelocity: HD 189733 A's Gaia DR3 value, -2.53 km/s: B's own, 1.5 +/- 1.2 km/s, is too uncertain to separate the pair
